subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below.
stimulus: Bangladesh will be receiving on Monday, November 1, 2021 at a has started vaccination center Ideal School & College, was formally launched Dhaka The campaign were administered to other districts outside Dhaka gradually It will be expanded administering COVID-19 vaccines to school children aged 12-17 years in capital Dhaka Students Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine doses 120 students Pfizer doses on an experimental basis in who October showed no side effects
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table : (i) Bangladesh has started administering COVID-19 vaccines to school children aged 12- 17 years in capital Dhaka. (ii) The campaign was formally launched on Monday, November 1, 2021 at a vaccination center Ideal School & College, Dhaka. (iii) It will be expanded to other districts outside Dhaka gradually. (iv) Students will be receiving Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine doses. (v) 120 students who were administered Pfizer doses on an experimental basis in October showed no side effects.
